user.title: Select BK215 batteries
user.description: Choose the batteries detected from SunEnergyXT. Related sensors and limits will be filled in automatically.

battery_manual.title: Battery sensors
battery_manual.description: No compatible BK215 device was found. Choose the system's SoC and limits manually.

inverters.title: Assign inverters
inverters.description: Choose one or two detected inverter devices per BK215. Unknown devices can be assigned manually.

grid.title: Select the grid meter
grid.description: Use a signed instantaneous grid power sensor (positive = import, negative = export).

confirm.title: Start energy management
confirm.description: Disable any other automation writing to the same inverter power limits before completing setup. EMS starts automatically when measurements are valid.

data.ack: I have disabled other inverter controllers

correct.title: Review battery mapping
correct.description: Change only if the suggested battery sensors or limits are wrong.

ratings.title: Inverter rated power
ratings.description: Only needed when the inverter rating cannot be detected.

reconfigure.title: Change EMS devices
reconfigure.description: Select BK215 systems, then review inverters and the meter. Operating settings are kept.

inverters_manual.title: Select inverter power limits manually
inverters_manual.description: Choose only writable power limits in % or W.

error.invalid_setup: Check the selected sensors and power limits.
error.duplicate_inverter: Each inverter can only be assigned once.
error.invalid_inverter: Choose one or two inverter limits per battery.
error.inverter_stop_failed: Could not safely lower a previous inverter. Check the device and try again.
